title: Agent job runner
description: Launches agent jobs (CI-fix jobs, scheduled and event jobs, Breakroom Run) through deploy/claude-headless.sh and the agent-slots cap, and sweeps finished runs onto their agents, whether or not the console is up. The console keeps the Breakroom UI and sends jobs here over the socket.

sudo.why: launch scheduled job types that are due (headless sessions run as root, as today)
book finished runs onto their agents
job types, owners, last and next runs
run the job requests the console sent (spooled in the service's data folder, re-checked by root)

actions.title: Run a job
actions.description: Route one run to the owning agent and launch it.

actions.title: Fire a job event
actions.description: Launch the job types an event triggers (e.g. ci-red).

replaces.name: jobs_run
replaces.where: the agent-swarm plugin: server/__init__.py (/jobs/run, /jobs/hire launch from the container)

replaces.name: axf-agent-jobs
replaces.where: scheduled job types (jobs.mjs due --run) when a cron line runs them
